title: Aaja Akbar Teri Sughra Mar Na Jaway
body:
Sani)
Nae pal da veer bharosa saa aaway ya na away..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Mar Jana baad teray vichri veer beemar aay
Veeran gharaan wich kalli kamsin Zahra kurlaye..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aasaa’n day deeway Main baal kay rondi rae aan
Chan veer aay dardaa’n mari haye vayn hijar day paye..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Waikhdiyan raat dinay teriyan veeran rahwaa’n
Laila da laal aay nana menu layn Madinay aaye..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ja kay rozay tay Main veera aeho faryad karaa’n
Nana satwee da waada mera Akbar veer nibhaye..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jholiyan cha kay jaha’n tay haye Touseef dua mangda
Aay dard wichora aa kay Narjis da laal mukaye..
